title: Deep Learning Architectural Designs for Super-Resolution of Noisy Images
venueFull: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
summary: Studies joint denoising and super-resolution with two designs: 'in-network' fuses denoising at the feature level, and 'pre-network' denoises before upsampling. In-network works best when training and test noise match; pre-network generalizes better to unseen corruptions.
